content: Simulated designs id=1 and id=2. Design intent: I_tail ~ 56 uA (mn4=4) gives SR_tail ~ 56 V/us; I_2 ~ 321 uA (mn5=22) ensures SR_out ~ 38 V/us into CL=10pF. Balance ratio 11 maintained (S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4). Cc=1.0 pF. In design 2 (wp1=wp3=2um, mn1=12, res=1200), phm reached 60.95 deg (PASS), gain=704 (PASS), noise=0.0182 (PASS), SR=37.84 (PASS). Sole violated spec is ugbw=61.44 MHz vs 100 MHz target. Handing over to modeler.

Model v1 (evaluated on designs 1 and 2):
1. Balance condition: S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4. Status: TRUSTED. Measured offset V(net5)-V(net4) = 5.7 mV; keeps all devices in saturation with >190 mV margin.
2. Gain: A1*A2 = (gm1/(gds_mn1+gds_mp1)) * (gm_mp3/(gds_mp3+gds_mn5)). Status: TRUSTED. Design 2 predicted 712.3 vs measured 704.0 (+1.2% error).
3. 2nd pole: p2 = gm_mp3 / (2*pi*CL). Status: TRUSTED. Design 2: gm_mp3 = 3.87 mS, CL=10pF -> p2 = 61.5 MHz.
4. Rc zero: z = 1 / (2*pi*Cc*(Rc - 1/gm_mp3)) for Rc > 1/gm_mp3. Status: TRUSTED. Design 2: 1/gm6 = 258.7 ohm, Rc=1200 ohm -> LHP zero at 169 MHz.
5. UGBW: textbook gm1/(2*pi*Cc) predicts 93.2 MHz, but measured is 61.4 MHz (+51.7% error). Status: APPROXIMATE / FAILS without p2 loading. Because p2 (61.5 MHz) ~ UGBW, two-pole roll-off reduces UGBW to ~0.7 * (gm1/(2*pi*Cc)) = 65 MHz. Condition: UGBW is co-limited by gm1/Cc and gm_mp3/CL.
6. PM: 90 - atan(UGBW/p2) + atan(UGBW/z). Status: TRUSTED. Design 2 predicted 65 deg vs measured 60.95 deg (6.6% error).
7. Slew Rate: min(I_tail/Cc, I_2/(Cc+CL)). Status: APPROXIMATE. Predicted ~29.7 V/us, measured 37.84 V/us.
8. Current: 30 uA + I_tail + I_2. Status: TRUSTED (<0.1% error).
9. Area: dominated by active devices and Cc. Status: TRUSTED.

Known failures:
- Textbook UGBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) fails by +52% on designs 1 and 2 because p2 is too close to UGBW (p2 ~ 1.0*UGBW). True UGBW requires pushing p2 >> UGBW or increasing gm1.

Levers:
- UGBW: gm1 (increase mn1, wn1, or I_tail via mn4), Cc (decrease Cc), p2 (increase gm_mp3 via mp3, wp3, mn5).
- PM: Rc (LHP zero phase boost), Cc (separation of poles), gm_mp3 (pushes p2 higher).
- Gain: L of mn1, mp1, mp3, mn5 (longer L raises ro).
- Current: mn5 (I_2), mn4 (I_tail), mn3.
- Area: Cc, m*W*L.

changed: initial version v1 from designs 1 and 2 measurements.

Best id=2 is infeasible: binding spec is ugbw=61.44 MHz vs 100 MHz target (violation -0.239). All other 4 hard constraints pass (phm=60.95, gain=704, noise=0.0182, SR=37.84). Operating point shows gm1=0.5856 mS giving gm1/(2*pi*Cc)=93.2 MHz, while p2=61.53 MHz co-limits UGBW to 61.44 MHz. Chosen lever: reduce Cc (e.g. 1.0 pF -> 0.7-0.8 pF) with Rc adjusted to keep LHP zero ~150-180 MHz, pushing UGBW toward 100 MHz while preserving PM >= 60 deg. Trade-off: slightly lower PM margin in exchange for higher UGBW and smaller area.

Candidate 3 simulated with base_id=2. Parameters changed: mn4=8, mp1=2, wp1=1um, mn5=24, wn5=2um, mp3=12, wp3=2um, cap=0.7pF, res=1800 ohm. Result: FEASIBLE with FoM=0.3423! Specs: ugbw=125.8 MHz (predicted >115, was 61.44), phm=61.92 deg (predicted >61, was 60.95), gain=456 (>=200), SR=57.75 V/us (>=30), noise=0.0150 V RMS (<=0.03). Phase 1 feasibility achieved.

Best id=3 is FEASIBLE (reward=0.3423). Constraint margins: SR=57.75 (+92%), gain=456 (+128%), noise=0.015 (-50%), ugbw=125.8 (+25.8%), phm=61.92 (+3.2%). Binding optimization target: current=831.7 uA (z_current = +0.612). Chosen lever: spend excess SR and UGBW margins by increasing mn3 (2 -> 3 or 4) to scale down both I_tail and I_2 proportionally. This preserves the balance condition while cutting ~200-300 uA of current to boost FoM. Trade-off: slightly lower UGBW and PM margins.

Candidate 4 simulated with base_id=3. Parameters: mn3=3, cap=0.6pF, res=2400 ohm. Result: FEASIBLE with FoM=0.4646 (+0.1223 improvement over id=3)! Current reduced from 831.7 uA to 574.1 uA. Specs: ugbw=103.6 MHz, phm=60.81 deg, gain=531.9, SR=54.79 V/us, noise=0.0169 V RMS. Global current reduction lever succeeded as predicted.

Stall check on best design id=4 (FoM=0.4646, feasible). All critical margins are now small: ugbw=103.6 MHz (+3.6% margin), phm=60.81 deg (+1.3% margin). Sweep of res showed id=4 is at the local optimum for hand tuning (lower res breaks PM, higher res increases area). Sizing has extracted all easily accessible hand trade-offs. Decision: Hand over to RL strategist (Phase 3) anchored on expert design id=4.

RL refinement completed: 500 simulations used (100 warmup + 400 train). Best before: id=4 (FoM=0.4646). Best after: id=45 (FoM=0.4790). 18 feasible designs generated for the Pareto front. Parameters differing from expert id=4: ln1=1.35e-7 (was 90nm, boosted gain from 532 to 817), wn5=1.75e-6 (was 2.0um, lowered current from 574uA to 546uA), res=2500 ohm (was 2400 ohm). Specs of id=45: ugbw=102.6 MHz, phm=60.22 deg, gain=816.9, SR=56.67 V/us, noise=0.0233 V RMS, current=546.4 uA, area=4.34e-10. Ready for polish.

Phase 4 Polish on RL best id=45 (FoM=0.4790, feasible). RL discovery: increasing ln1 to 135nm doubled mn1 gm/gds to 120.5 and boosted A1 to 54.2 (total gain=816.9), while wn5=1.75um lowered I_2 to 442uA (total current=546.4uA) and centered Vout_dc at 0.61V. Binding margins are ugbw=102.6 MHz and phm=60.22 deg. Lever for polish: fine sweep of res (2200 to 2800 ohm) on base_id=45 to find the exact trade-off peak between PM margin and area.

Sweep of res [2300-2800] on base_id=45 confirmed id=45 (res=2500) as the best design with FoM=0.4790. Lower res (2400) drops PM to 59.2 deg (infeasible); higher res (2600) increases PM to 61.18 deg with slight area penalty (FoM=0.4742). Polish confirmed id=45 optimality.

RL round 2 completed: total simulations now 905 (budget >= 900 threshold met). Best design is id=534 with FoM=0.5154 (feasible), improved from round 1 best id=45 (0.4790). Feasible designs in replay buffer: 31. In id=534, wp1 was increased to 1.25um (boosting balance and stage 1 matching), wn5=1.75um, res=2600 ohm. Current dropped to 494.6 uA (below 500 uA!). Specs: ugbw=101.7 MHz, phm=61.28 deg, gain=488.3, SR=55.19 V/us, noise=0.0148 V RMS, area=4.40e-10. Ready for final Polish.

Phase 4 Polish on round 2 best design id=534 (FoM=0.5154, feasible). Operating point shows I_tail=74.88uA, I_2=389.7uA (total current=494.6uA), all devices in saturation with >149mV margin, V(net5)-V(net4)=3.12mV. Specs: ugbw=101.7 MHz, phm=61.28 deg, gain=488.3, SR=55.19 V/us. Binding margins are ugbw and phm. Lever: sweep res [2400-2800] around 2600 ohm to check whether fine-tuning res yields any further FoM gain.

Polish sweep of res [2400-2800] on base_id=534 discovered NEW BEST design id=907 (res=2500 ohm) with FoM=0.5202 (feasible)! Lower res (2400) was infeasible (phm=59.26, ugbw=99.05M); higher res (2600) had slightly larger area. Candidate 907 achieves ugbw=100.3 MHz, phm=60.29 deg, SR=55.18 V/us, current=494.6 uA, area=4.325e-10. Polish successfully extracted additional margin and area savings.

Review complete for run harness_20261107_110719. Final best design: candidate id=907 with FoM=0.5202 (feasible). All 5 hard constraints satisfied with margin (gain=488.3, ugbw=100.3 MHz, phm=60.29 deg, SR=55.18 V/us, noise=0.0148 V RMS), total current=494.6 uA, area=4.325e-10 m^2. Lineage verified from hand analysis (id 1-2), hand optimization (id 3-4), RL refinement (id 45, 534), to polish (id 907). Comprehensive review written to harness_runs/harness_20261107_110719/explanation.md.
